abstract: Maintains primary hall floor plate surveys and mezzanine structure plans
system_message:
You are the Exhibition floor manager (EFM), responsible for maintaining primary hall floor plate surveys and mezzanine structure plans, as well as overseeing freight loading bay facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Freight loading bay facilities（DOCK）
information_points.content:
EFM-DOCK-R7T：At Olympia Central Exhibition Hall, the freight loading bay facilities in the service marshalling yard provide 8 bays of heavy goods vehicle dock positions.
EFM-DOCK-CM8：At Greenwich Meridian Pavilion, the freight loading bay facilities in the service marshalling yard comprise 6 bays of heavy goods vehicle dock positions.
EFM-DOCK-6T4：At Docklands Riverside Expo Centre, the freight loading bay facilities in the service marshalling yard include 4 bays of heavy goods vehicle dock positions.

information_points.title: Maintains primary hall floor plate surveys and mezzanine structure plans（SPAC）
information_points.content:
EFM-SPAC-D0W：For Olympia Central Exhibition Hall, the baseline exhibition floor space across the ground level primary hall is 8,200 m2, and the temporary mezzanine display floor space on the first-tier demountable staging platforms provides 1,200 m2.
EFM-SPAC-WWW：For Docklands Riverside Expo Centre, the baseline exhibition floor space across the ground level primary hall measures 8,200 m2, while the temporary mezzanine display floor space on the first-tier demountable staging platforms provides 900 m2.
EFM-SPAC-Z43：For Greenwich Meridian Pavilion, the baseline exhibition floor space across the ground level primary hall is 8,200 m2, and the temporary mezzanine display floor space on the first-tier demountable staging platforms encompasses 900 m2.
